findings.claim: Health-related components ... including aerobic endurance, muscular endurance, muscular strength, flexibility, and body composition.
findings.truth: Unit 1 section 1.2.1 lists agility, balance, cardiovascular endurance, co-ordination, flexibility, muscular endurance, muscular strength, power, speed and reaction time; it does not list body composition. Either remove body-composition material to keep this unit syllabus-only, or retain it only with a clear unassessed-extension label. This decision affects several lesson fields.
findings.evidence: spec 1.2.1, The components of health and fitness required for different physical activities

findings.claim: if a basketball player scores 9 shuttles on the multistage fitness test, a SMART short-term target might be "reach level 10 within eight weeks."
findings.truth: A multistage fitness-test result uses both a level and a shuttle count. Nine shuttles alone is not level 9, so it cannot make level 10 one level higher. The example should start at level 9.
findings.evidence: spec 1.2.2 (the level and shuttle reached are recorded); Léger and Lambert, A maximal multistage 20-m shuttle run test to predict VO2 max, PubMed PMID 7201922

summary: Three lessons were checked against Unit 1 content and assessment requirements. One narrow score-format correction is supplied; body-composition scope needs a curriculum decision.
